Compare the last two

Copy some text. Copy some other text. Press a shortcut to see what changed. ClipDiff lives in your menu bar, ready when you need it. You can copy text files too.

Get ClipDiff for Mac ↓⌥ Option+⌘ Command+C

01 Install

Get ClipDiff for Mac.

macOS 13 Ventura or later

The Mac repository has the current build and setup instructions. Its local release script builds ClipDiff.app and opens it. Finder integration is enabled separately in System Settings.

Mac installation instructions ↗/Source on GitHub

02 Use

Copy. Copy. Compare.

  1. 1.Start ClipDiff.app. It lives in your menu bar.
  2. 2.Copy the older text, then copy the newer text.
    You can copy text files too.
  3. 3.Press ⌥ Option+⌘ Command+C

Or choose Show Diff in the ClipDiff menu. Previous is on the left; current is on the right. Switch between side-by-side and unified views, and use Copy diff to copy the unified diff.

ClipDiff captures copies made after it starts. It retains only two captures and does not recover earlier clipboard history.

03 Tricks

A few useful ways to use it.

Compare two config files

Copy one file, then the other in Finder, and use Show Diff. Or copy exactly two files together to make them the comparison pair. Text files contribute their contents, and the viewer shows their filenames.

Compare copied text with a file

Copy a snippet from a browser or message, then right-click a local file and choose Compare with current ClipDiff capture.

Choose Enable Finder menu… in ClipDiff, then enable ClipDiff Finder Integration in macOS System Settings.

This works while monitoring is paused if a capture remains. If there is no capture, ClipDiff asks you to copy text or a file first while monitoring.

Compare two selected files

Select exactly two files in Finder, then choose Compare two selected files with ClipDiff. Finder can launch ClipDiff for this comparison, even if it is not already running. No previous capture is needed. Enable the Finder extension as described above.

Use your usual diff viewer

Choose an installed application from Diff viewer in the ClipDiff menu, such as FileMerge, Kaleidoscope, Beyond Compare, or Visual Studio Code. You can switch back to the built-in viewer at any time.

Supported viewers and setup ↗

Share the difference

Switch to unified view and use Copy diff. Paste the diff into an issue or message instead of pasting two complete blocks.

Make it fit your workflow

Choose Change Keyboard Shortcut… to change the shortcut. Turn off Monitor Clipboard to pause capture, or choose Clear Captured Text to discard the two captured values without changing your clipboard.

Comparisons are text-based. Files over 16 MiB are not read; binary or unusable files contribute a filename and reason. Encoding and fallback details.

What happens to the text?

ClipDiff never uploads captures. The built-in viewer keeps them in memory; quitting discards them. External viewers require temporary plaintext files, with a warning before first use and best-effort cleanup.
